{{Top|leg}}
'''Cogitative Theory Units''' were part of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] programming. A submodule of the [[obedience-rational module]], the Cogitative Theory Unit, in concert with the [[Obedience Module]], interacted to produce logical and acceptable droid behavior. Cogitative Theory Units comprised a [[Memory Storage Unit]], a [[Logic and Processing Unit]], and an [[Initiative Unit]]. The system allowed a droid to think.<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> [[Model E baby-sitting droid]]s used Cogitative Theory Units which contained the "personality" of the droids.<ref name="KA">[[Droids (1994) 5|''Droids'' (1994) 5]]</ref>
